title: UniformInverseAffineSectionsBound
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, with $S$ quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme]. There exists $N\in\mathbf N$, $N>0$, such that for every affine open $U\subset S$ and quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ [pqf-def-coherent], the right derived functors of $\Gamma(f^{-1}U,-)$ vanish on $M$ in every degree $p\ge N$. Sections and their cohomology are the module-section functor and its right derived functors [def-sc-open-module-cohomology].

proof.text: Choose the base-change-stable bound n for f from [lem-pc-finite-support-hi] and take N=max(1,n). For every affine U, restrict M to V=f^{-1}U. Restriction preserves quasi-coherence, and the induced morphism V→U is a base change of f, so all higher direct images are quasi-coherent and vanish in degrees p≥N.

Affine vanishing [lem-pc-affine-vanishing] kills positive cohomology of those higher direct images. Leray degeneration [lem-pc-leray-degenerate-sections] identifies H^p(V,M|V) with sections of R^p(f_U)_*(M|V), which are zero for p≥N. Restriction of injective resolutions [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution] identifies these groups with the right derived functors of sections on V, applied to the original M on X [def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. The same N works for every U and M.
